title: NETWISE - Smart & Safe Internet Practices
description: A program designed to promote responsible and safe internet usage, particularly among students and young professionals, with emphasis on smart internet habits, online fraud prevention, digital ethics, digital footprints management etc.

title: CYBERWISE – 2-Day Workshop on Cybersecurity for Information Security Expertise
description: The CYBERWISE Workshop successfully created awareness and provided hands-on exposure to students, faculty, and staff on various aspects of cybersecurity, cybercrimes, and preventive measures. The two-day event featured expert talks, interactive discussions, and practical sessions, offering participants the opportunity to experience real-world cybersecurity practices and defense mechanisms.
